items.caption:
Welcome back to the Weekly Tokimeki Question! Today we’re keeping it simple: what is one small thing that made you smile today? ✨

For Marie, it was recently, while she was taking a walk with her son, when he got interested in a fallen leaf and picked it up, and it was so cute. His lively, happy expression made her smile.

It doesn’t have to be big. Sometimes life’s greatest joys can be found in the smallest moments, the ones we tend to rush past.

Think of that small thing and stay with the feeling for just a few seconds. Notice how it feels in your body. This is how we begin to cultivate our sensitivity to Tokimeki, by slowing down, noticing joy, and allowing ourselves to fully experience it.

📌 Share yours with us below, in a photo or a comment! We’ll be featuring some of your answers in an upcoming post💛

#artoftokimeki #reflection #journalprompt #journaling #sparkjoy
items.transcript: Let's try something simple today. Think of one small thing that made you smile today. Just one. It doesn't have to be big. A kind word, a quiet moment, a cup of tea. Stay with that feeling for a few seconds. If you'd like, share it. What is one small thing that made you smile today?

Welcome back to the Weekly Tokimeki Question! This week we’re reflecting on the small joys of your day! ❤️

Sometimes life feels too busy to reflect on the good things that happened, but we hope this is a gentle reminder to look back at your day and appreciate even the smallest things! It can truly change your perspective on your day ✨

📌Try this out with us:
① Take a moment to close your eyes and take a deep breath.
② Slowly reflect on your day. What is one joy-sparking thing in your life that you want to thank?
③ Write it down in your journal or in the comments!
④ We’d love for you all to share your little joys of the day and spread Tokimeki together!

We’ll be sharing some of your answers in a community highlight post soon, so don’t forget to share your little joys with us!👇

📌Comment a ❤️ to become one of our first, founding Tokimeki email community members! We’ll send you a DM with the link to join us!

#artoftokimeki #tokimeki #sparkjoy #reflect #gratitude
items.transcript: This week, try something quiet. Right now, pick up one thing near you and say thank you, your cup, your clothes, your space. Gratitude softens the way you think. If you like, share what you think. What is one joy-sparking thing in your life that you want to thank?
